questions.question: 80112. Which is the most effective non-cariogenic sugar substitute?
questions.explain: Xylitol is non-fermentable and also reduces Streptococcus mutans growth.

questions.question: 80111. Which of the following statements about incidence is TRUE?
questions.option2: It measures new cases over a period
questions.option3: It is always expressed as a proportion
questions.option4: It cannot be calculated in cohort studies
questions.explain:
Incidence refers to the occurrence of new cases of a disease in a specified population during a specified period of time. It measures the risk of developing the disease.
Example:
If 1,000 disease-free people are followed for 1 year and 50 develop the disease, the incidence is based on those 50 new cases.

questions.question: 80110. The concept of "Health for All" was a major goal of the:
questions.option4: National Institute of Dental and Craniofacial Research
questions.explain:
The concept of “Health for All” was formally adopted as a major global health goal at the International Conference on Primary Health Care, held in Alma-Ata, USSR, in 1978.
The Alma-Ata Declaration emphasized Primary Health Care (PHC) as the key strategy for achieving “Health for All”, with the goal of enabling people worldwide to attain a level of health that permits them to lead socially and economically productive lives.

questions.question: 80109. Sodium fluoride varnish contains how much NaF?
questions.explain: NaF varnish is 5% (about 22,600 ppm F). Stannous fluoride solution is 8%.

questions.question: 80108. Screening, restoration and scaling are examples of:
questions.explain: Secondary prevention (early diagnosis and prompt treatment) acts in early pathogenesis. The aim is to detect disease early and treat it before it advances and causes damage or disability.

questions.question: 80107. What is the ultimate target of Dental Health Education?
questions.explain: Acquiring knowledge is only an initial step in health education. The ultimate objective is to transform that knowledge into positive attitudes and long-term, daily oral hygiene behavior changes.

questions.question: 80106. The main purpose of a rural dental survey is to—
questions.option1: Provide complete restorative treatment to every resident
questions.option2: Determine the prevalence and distribution of oral diseases
questions.option3: Identify patients suitable for  dental treatment
questions.option4: Establish a specialist dental centre in every rural Area
questions.explain:
A survey primarily collects epidemiological information about oral diseases.
It helps determine disease prevalence, distribution, and treatment needs.
The findings can guide planning of preventive and curative services.
Comprehensive treatment is not the primary purpose of a survey.

questions.question: 80105. Which behavior management technique is contraindicated in a child with severe asthma?
questions.explain: The hand-over-mouth exercise (HOME) involves temporarily covering the child’s mouth to reduce disruptive behavior. It is contraindicated in children with respiratory problems, including severe asthma, because it may compromise breathing and precipitate respiratory distress.

questions.question: 80104. A salesperson receives a 12% commission on the sale of each shirt. If he earns a total commission of Tk. 2,880 by selling 30 shirts, what is the selling price of each shirt?
questions.explain:
Question: A salesperson receives a 12% commission on the sale of each shirt. If he earns a total commission of Tk. 2,880 by selling 30 shirts, what is the selling price of each shirt?

Solution:
30টি শার্ট বিক্রি করে মোট কমিশন = Tk. 2,880
কমিশনের হার = 12%

ধরি,
30টি শার্টের মোট বিক্রয়মূল্য = Tk. x

প্রশ্নানুসারে,
x-এর 12% = 2,880
⇒ (12x/100) = 2880
⇒ 12x = 288000
⇒ x = 24000

সুতরাং, 30টি শার্টের মোট বিক্রয়মূল্য = Tk. 24,000
অতএব, প্রতিটি শার্টের বিক্রয়মূল্য = 24000/30
= Tk. 800

questions.question: 80103. If (x - 3) is a factor of the polynomial x<sup>3</sup> + 2x<sup>2</sup> - px - 18, what is the value of p?
questions.explain:
Question: If (x - 3) is a factor of the polynomial x3 + 2x2 - px - 18, what is the value of p?

Solution:
ধরি,
f(x) = x3 + 2x2 - px - 18

যেহেতু (x - 3) হলো f(x)-এর একটি উৎপাদক, Factor Theorem অনুযায়ী, f(3) = 0

সুতরাং,
33 + 2(32) - 3p - 18 = 0
⇒ 27 + 18 - 3p - 18 = 0
⇒ 27 - 3p = 0
⇒ 3p = 27
⇒ p = 9

অতএব, p-এর মান = 9

questions.question: 80102. A starts a business with Tk. 40,000. After 3 months, B joins the business with Tk. 60,000. If the total profit at the end of the year is Tk. 17,000, what is B's share of the profit?
questions.explain:
Question: A starts a business with Tk. 40,000. After 3 months, B joins the business with Tk. 60,000. If the total profit at the end of the year is Tk. 17,000, what is B's share of the profit?

Solution:
A-এর বিনিয়োগ = Tk. 40,000
A-এর বিনিয়োগের সময় = 12 মাস

সুতরাং,
A-এর মূলধন × সময় = 40,000 × 12
= 480,000

B 3 মাস পরে ব্যবসায় যোগ দেয়।

সুতরাং,
B-এর বিনিয়োগের সময় = 12 - 3
= 9 মাস

B-এর বিনিয়োগ = Tk. 60,000

অতএব,
B-এর মূলধন × সময় = 60,000 × 9
= 540,000

সুতরাং, A ও B-এর লাভের অনুপাত = 480,000 : 540,000
= 8 : 9

মোট লাভ = Tk. 17,000

অতএব, B-এর লাভের অংশ = 17,000 × {9/(8 + 9)}
= 17,000 × (9/17)
= Tk. 9,000

questions.question: 80101. The most effective method of oral health education for school children is—
questions.explain: Children learn better through visual and practical methods. Demonstration of tooth brushing and oral hygiene techniques improves understanding and retention. Interactive learning changes behavior more effectively than lectures alone. Therefore, demonstrations are widely used in school health programs.

questions.question: 80100. What is the 12th term of the sequence 3, 7, 19, 55, 163, .....?
questions.explain:
Question: What is the 12th term of the sequence 3, 7, 19, 55, 163, .....?

Solution:
প্রদত্ত ধারা, 3, 7, 19, 55, 163, .....

লক্ষ্য করি,
3 = 2 × 30 + 1
7 = 2 × 31 + 1
19 = 2 × 32 + 1
55 = 2 × 33 + 1
163 = 2 × 34 + 1

সুতরাং, ধারাটির n-তম পদ, an = 2 × 3n - 1 + 1

অতএব, 12তম পদ,
a12 = 2 × 312 - 1 + 1
= 2 × 311 + 1

questions.question: 80099. The "calcium fluoride reservoir" formed after topical fluoride application:
questions.explain: Calcium fluoride deposits remain on the enamel and in plaque. When an acid attack lowers the pH, they release fluoride ions. This promotes remineralization and inhibits demineralization right where it is needed.

questions.question: 80098. A major logistical challenge in rural oral health surveys is—
questions.explain:
Rural communities may be geographically dispersed and difficult to access.
Transportation of personnel, instruments, and records can therefore be challenging.
Proper field planning can reduce these logistical problems.
Mobile or outreach-based services may be useful in such settings.

questions.question: 80097. Tickets numbered from 1 to 30 are mixed thoroughly, and one ticket is drawn at random. What is the probability that the number on the ticket is a multiple of 4 or 5?
questions.explain:
Question: Tickets numbered from 1 to 30 are mixed thoroughly, and one ticket is drawn at random. What is the probability that the number on the ticket is a multiple of 4 or 5?

Solution:
1 থেকে 30 পর্যন্ত মোট টিকিটের সংখ্যা = 30
4-এর গুণিতকগুলো হলো: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28
অতএব, 4-এর গুণিতকের সংখ্যা = 7

5-এর গুণিতকগুলো হলো: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30
অতএব, 5-এর গুণিতকের সংখ্যা = 6

এখানে 20 উভয় তালিকাতেই আছে, তাই এটি একবারই গণনা করতে হবে।

সুতরাং, 4 অথবা 5-এর গুণিতকের মোট সংখ্যা = 7 + 6 - 1
= 12

অতএব, প্রয়োজনীয় সম্ভাবনা = 12/30
= 2/5

questions.question: 80096. What is the volume of a sphere having a diameter of 18 meters in cubic meters?
questions.explain:
Question: What is the volume of a sphere having a diameter of 18 meters in cubic meters?

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
গোলকের ব্যাস = 18 m

সুতরাং, গোলকের ব্যাসার্ধ, r = 18/2 = 9 m

আমরা জানি,
গোলকের আয়তন = (4/3)πr3

সুতরাং,
গোলকের আয়তন = (4/3)π(9)3
= (4/3)π × 729
= 972π ঘনমিটার

অতএব, গোলকের আয়তন = 972π ঘনমিটার

questions.question: 80095. A fluoride concentration of 1 ppm in drinking water means:
questions.option1: 1 mg fluoride in 100 mL of water
questions.option2: 1 mg fluoride in 1 liter of water
questions.option3: 1 g fluoride in 1 liter of water
questions.option4: 0.1 mg fluoride in 1 liter of water
questions.explain: For dilute aqueous solutions, 1 ppm ≈ 1 mg/L. Therefore, 1 ppm fluoride = 1 mg of fluoride per liter of water.

questions.question: 80094. If 8sinθ + 15cosθ = 17, then what is 8cosθ - 15sinθ equal to?
questions.explain:
Question: If 8sinθ + 15cosθ = 17, then what is 8cosθ - 15sinθ equal to?

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
8sinθ + 15cosθ = 17

আমরা জানি,
(8sinθ + 15cosθ)2 + (8cosθ - 15sinθ)2 = 82 + 152

সুতরাং,
172 + (8cosθ - 15sinθ)2 = 64 + 225
⇒ 289 + (8cosθ - 15sinθ)2 = 289
⇒ (8cosθ - 15sinθ)2 = 0
⇒ 8cosθ - 15sinθ = 0

অতএব, 8cosθ - 15sinθ-এর মান 0

questions.question: 80093. Which of the following is considered an "Advanced Behavior Guidance Technique"?
questions.explain:
Protective stabilization is classified as an advanced behavior guidance technique and involves restricting a patient's movement when necessary to safely deliver dental care.
Tell-show-do  — Basic/non-pharmacological technique.
 Distraction  — Basic behavior management technique.
 Voice control  — Basic/non-pharmacological technique.

questions.question: 80092. Selecting whole naturally occurring groups (e.g., selecting entire classrooms or villages) and examining every individual within those selected groups is an example of:
questions.explain: Cluster sampling partitions the population into naturally occurring heterogeneous groups or clusters (e.g., schools, districts). Whole clusters are randomly selected, and either all or a sample of units within selected clusters are evaluated.

questions.question: 80091. The most appropriate outcome of a community oral health education programme is—
questions.option1: Increased knowledge without any change in oral health behavior
questions.option2: Increased dependence on emergency dental treatment
questions.option3: Improved knowledge, healthier behavior, and better oral health outcomes
questions.explain:
Effective health education should ultimately influence behavior.
Improved knowledge alone may not necessarily produce healthier practices.
Sustained behavioral change can contribute to improved oral health outcomes.
Programme evaluation should therefore assess both knowledge and behavior where possible.

questions.question: 80090. Which of the following is a live attenuated vaccine?
questions.explain: Live attenuated vaccines include BCG, measles and OPV. IPV is a killed (inactivated) vaccine and tetanus is a toxoid vaccine. Hepatitis B is a subunit/recombinant vaccine.

questions.question: 80089. In 2025, 12% of ABC Ltd.'s annual revenue amounted to Tk. 3,600. In 2026, its annual revenue increased by Tk. 7,500 compared with 2025. What was the percentage increase in annual revenue?
questions.explain:
Question: In 2025, 12% of ABC Ltd.'s annual revenue amounted to Tk. 3,600. In 2026, its annual revenue increased by Tk. 7,500 compared with 2025. What was the percentage increase in annual revenue?

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
2025 সালের বার্ষিক আয়ের 12% = Tk. 3,600

সুতরাং, 2025 সালের বার্ষিক আয় = (3,600 × 100)/12
= Tk. 30,000

আবার,
2026 সালে আয় বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে = Tk. 7,500

আমরা জানি,
শতকরা বৃদ্ধি = (বৃদ্ধির পরিমাণ/পূর্বের আয়) × 100

সুতরাং, শতকরা বৃদ্ধি = (7,500/30,000) × 100
= 25%

অতএব, 2026 সালে ABC Ltd.-এর বার্ষিক আয় 2025 সালের তুলনায় 25% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে।

questions.question: 80088. Which of the following is classified as a "Non-operating" dental ancillary?
questions.explain: A non-operating dental ancillary does not provide direct clinical dental treatment. A dental secretary/receptionist/assistant performs administrative duties such as scheduling appointments, maintaining records, billing, and patient coordination.

questions.question: 80087. Which antibody is primarily involved in local immunity in the oral cavity?
questions.explain:
Secretory IgA (sIgA) is the principal antibody involved in local/mucosal immunity of the oral cavity. It is present in saliva and other secretions and helps prevent microbial adhesion and colonization on oral surfaces.
 IgG  — Predominantly a systemic antibody; present in gingival crevicular fluid but not the main salivary antibody.
IgM  — Important in early/systemic immune responses but is not the primary antibody of mucosal secretions.
 IgE  — Mainly associated with allergic reactions and parasitic infections.

questions.question: 80086. If y : x = 3 : 7 and 2x + y = 51, then what is the value of y?
questions.explain:
Question: If y : x = 3 : 7 and 2x + y = 51, then what is the value of y?

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
y : x = 3 : 7

ধরি,
y = 3k এবং x = 7k

আবার, 2x + y = 51

মান বসিয়ে পাই,
2(7k) + 3k = 51
⇒ 14k + 3k = 51
⇒ 17k = 51
⇒ k = 3

সুতরাং,
y = 3k
⇒ y = 3 × 3
⇒ y = 9

অতএব, y-এর মান = 9

questions.question: 80085. The "Stephan curve" demonstrates:
questions.option1: The rise in plaque pH after sugar consumption
questions.option2: The fall in plaque pH after sugar consumption
questions.option3: The effect of fluoride on plaque pH
questions.option4: The effect of saliva on plaque pH
questions.explain:
The Stephan curve represents the change in dental plaque pH following consumption of fermentable carbohydrates (sugar).
After sugar intake, plaque bacteria produce acids, causing a rapid fall in plaque pH. When the pH falls below the critical pH of enamel (≈5.5), demineralization begins. Saliva gradually neutralizes the acids, so the plaque pH slowly returns to its resting level, allowing remineralization.

questions.question: 80084. What is the lethal dose of fluoride for an adult?
questions.explain: The traditionally cited probable toxic/lethal dose of fluoride for an adult is approximately 2.5–10 g of fluoride (as fluoride ion), although the actual toxic dose varies with body weight, formulation, and circumstances.

questions.question: 80083. Find the value of n, if 27<sup>n - (2/3)</sup> = 9.
questions.explain:
Question: Find the value of n, if 27n - (2/3) = 9.

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
27n - (2/3) = 9
⇒ (33)n - (2/3) = 32
⇒ 33n - 2 = 32
⇒ 3n - 2 = 2 [ উভয় পাশে ভিত্তি সমান ]
⇒ 3n = 4
⇒ n = 4/3

অতএব, n-এর মান = 4/3

questions.question: 80082. The DMFT index is primarily an index of:
questions.explain:
The DMFT index measures the cumulative dental caries experience in permanent teeth:
D = Decayed teeth
M = Missing due to caries teeth
F = Filled teeth
T = Teeth

questions.question: 80081. Measles-Rubella (MR-1) vaccine is given at the age of:
questions.explain: MR-1 is given at 9 months and MR-2 at 15 months.

questions.question: 80080. Which is an example of artificial passive immunity?
questions.explain: Artificial passive immunity means giving pre-formed antibodies. It gives immediate but short-lived protection.

questions.question: 80079. If the sum of the squares of three positive numbers is 53, and the sum of the products of each pair is 34, what is the sum of the three numbers?
questions.explain:
Question: If the sum of the squares of three positive numbers is 53, and the sum of the products of each pair is 34, what is the sum of the three numbers?

Solution:
ধরি,
তিনটি ধনাত্মক সংখ্যা a, b, c

প্রশ্নানুসারে,
a2 + b2 + c2 = 53 এবং ab + bc + ca = 34

আমরা জানি,
(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

সুতরাং,
(a + b + c)2 = 53 + 2 × 34
⇒ (a + b + c)2 = 53 + 68
⇒ (a + b + c)2 = 121
⇒ a + b + c = 11  [যেহেতু সংখ্যাগুলো ধনাত্মক]

অতএব, তিনটি সংখ্যার যোগফল 11

questions.question: 80078. Which dental ancillary is specifically trained to provide preventive oral-health services ?
questions.explain: A dental hygienist is specifically trained to provide preventive oral-health services such as scaling, plaque/calculus removal, oral hygiene instruction, and preventive education, depending on the scope of practice in the jurisdiction.

questions.question: 80077. Scaling and root planing in periodontal disease are best classified as:
questions.explain: Scaling and root planing (SRP) is an etiologic (cause-directed) periodontal therapy because it removes plaque, calculus, and bacterial deposits from tooth surfaces, thereby reducing the primary local etiologic factors responsible for periodontal inflammation.

questions.question: 80076. For what principal amount will the simple interest at 6% per annum for 2 years and 6 months equal the simple interest earned on Tk. 1500 at 5% per annum for 4 years?
questions.explain:
Question: For what principal amount will the simple interest at 6% per annum for 2 years and 6 months equal the simple interest earned on Tk. 1500 at 5% per annum for 4 years?

Solution:
ধরি,
নির্ণেয় মূলধন = Tk. x

আমরা জানি,
সরল সুদ = (মূলধন × সুদের হার × সময়)/100

প্রথম ক্ষেত্রে,
সময় = 2 বছর 6 মাস
= 2 + (6/12) বছর
= (5/2) বছর

সুতরাং, প্রথম মূলধনের সরল সুদ = {x × 6 × (5/2)}/100

দ্বিতীয় ক্ষেত্রে, Tk. 1500-এর 5% হারে 4 বছরের সরল সুদ = (1500 × 5 × 4)/100

প্রশ্নানুসারে,
উভয় ক্ষেত্রের সুদ সমান
{x × 6 × (5/2)}/100 = (1500 × 5 × 4)/100
⇒ 15x = 30000
⇒ x = 2000

অতএব, নির্ণেয় মূলধন = Tk. 2000

questions.question: 80075. CDR,MMR and IMR are examples of:
questions.explain: Health care delivery indicators show the availability and coverage of services, such as doctor–population and bed–population ratios. Mortality indicators include CDR, IMR and MMR. Morbidity indicators include incidence and prevalence.

questions.question: 80074. The length of each side of a square is decreased by 30%. What is the ratio of the area of the new square to the area of the original square?
questions.explain:
Question: The length of each side of a square is decreased by 30%. What is the ratio of the area of the new square to the area of the original square?

Solution:
ধরি,
বর্গক্ষেত্রটির মূল বাহুর দৈর্ঘ্য = 100 একক
তাহলে, মূল ক্ষেত্রফল = 100 × 100
= 10000 বর্গ একক

প্রতিটি বাহুর দৈর্ঘ্য 30% কমানো হলে,
নতুন বাহুর দৈর্ঘ্য = 100 - 30
= 70 একক

সুতরাং, নতুন ক্ষেত্রফল = 70 × 70
= 4900 বর্গ একক

অতএব, নতুন বর্গক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল : মূল বর্গক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল = 4900 : 10000
= 49 : 100

questions.question: 80073. Pit and fissure sealant application is an example of which level of prevention?
questions.explain: Sealants and fluoride application are primary prevention at the specific protection level, acting in the pre-pathogenesis phase.

questions.question: 80072. According to Blum's model, which determinant has the greatest influence on health?
questions.explain: Environment has the largest influence in Blum's model. Health care services have the smallest single influence

questions.question: 80071. Which concept of health emphasizes the ability to accomplish social roles and responsibilities?
questions.explain: The psychosocial concept treats health as both a biological and a psychosocial phenomenon. It is influenced by social, psychological, cultural, economic and political factors. The biomedical concept only considers the absence of disease, and the ecological concept focuses on man–environment equilibrium.

questions.question: 80070. Which concept of health is based on the "germ theory of disease"?
questions.explain: Explanation: The biomedical concept defines health as the mere absence of disease. It downplays social, cultural and environmental determinants.

questions.question: 80069. Find x, given the inequality, 9 - 4x ≥ 21.
questions.explain:
Question: Find x, given the inequality, 9 - 4x ≥ 21.

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
9 - 4x ≥ 21
⇒ - 4x ≥ 12 [উভয় পাশ থেকে 9 বিয়োগ করে]
⇒ x ≤ - 3 [উভয় পাশকে - 4 দিয়ে ভাগ করলে অসমতার চিহ্নের দিক পরিবর্তিত হয়]

অতএব, interval notation-এ, x ∈ (- ∞, - 3]

questions.question: 80068. According to the WHO definition, health is best described as:
questions.option2: A state of complete physical, mental and social well-being
questions.option3: Ability to perform normal daily activities
questions.explain: According to the WHO Constitution (1948), health is defined as “a state of complete physical, mental and social well-being and not merely the absence of disease or infirmity.”

questions.question: 80067. Rafi took one-sixth of the chocolates from a box. The remaining chocolates were then equally distributed among Rafi and his four friends. If Rafi received a total of 30 chocolates, how many chocolates did each friend get?
questions.explain:
Question: Rafi took one-sixth of the chocolates from a box. The remaining chocolates were then equally distributed among Rafi and his four friends. If Rafi received a total of 30 chocolates, how many chocolates did each friend get?

Solution:
ধরি,
বাক্সে মোট চকোলেটের সংখ্যা = x

রাফি প্রথমে নিয়েছে = (x/6)
অবশিষ্ট চকোলেট = x - (x/6)
= (5x/6)

অবশিষ্ট চকোলেটগুলো রাফি ও তার 4 জন বন্ধু, অর্থাৎ মোট 5 জনের মধ্যে সমানভাবে ভাগ করা হয়েছে।

সুতরাং, প্রত্যেকে পেয়েছে = (5x/6) ÷ 5
= (x/6)

অতএব, রাফি মোট পেয়েছে = প্রথমে নেওয়া চকোলেট + পরে ভাগে পাওয়া চকোলেট
= (x/6) + (x/6)
= (x/3)

প্রশ্নানুসারে,
(x/3) = 30
⇒ x = 90

এখন, প্রত্যেক বন্ধু পেয়েছে = (x/6)
= (90/6)
= 15টি চকোলেট

অতএব, প্রত্যেক বন্ধু 15টি চকোলেট পেয়েছে।

questions.question: 80065. A train can travel 25% faster than a car. Both start from point A at the same time and reach point B, 150 km away, at the same time. During the journey, the train stops for a total of 15 minutes at different stations. What is the speed of the train?
questions.explain:
Question: A train can travel 25% faster than a car. Both start from point A at the same time and reach point B, 150 km away, at the same time. During the journey, the train stops for a total of 15 minutes at different stations. What is the speed of the train?

Solution:
ধরি,
গাড়ির গতি = x km/h

ট্রেনের গতি গাড়ির চেয়ে 25% বেশি।

সুতরাং, ট্রেনের গতি = x + x এর 25%
= x + (x/4)
= 5x/4 km/h

গাড়ির 150 km পথ অতিক্রম করতে সময় লাগে = 150/x ঘণ্টা

ট্রেনের 150 km পথ অতিক্রম করতে চলন্ত অবস্থায় সময় লাগে = 150/(5x/4)
= 120/x ঘণ্টা

আবার, ট্রেনটি স্টেশনে মোট 15 মিনিট থেমেছিল।

15 মিনিট = 15/60 = 1/4 ঘণ্টা

যেহেতু গাড়ি ও ট্রেন একই সময়ে গন্তব্যে পৌঁছায়,
150/x = (120/x) + (1/4)
⇒ 30/x = 1/4
⇒ x = 120

অতএব, ট্রেনের গতি = (5 × 120)/4
= 150 km/h

questions.question: 80064. A trapezium has an area of 154 square cm. If the lengths of its two parallel sides are 12 cm and 16 cm, what is the perpendicular distance between the parallel sides?
questions.explain:
Question: A trapezium has an area of 154 square cm. If the lengths of its two parallel sides are 12 cm and 16 cm, what is the perpendicular distance between the parallel sides?

Solution:
আমরা জানি,
ট্রাপিজিয়ামের ক্ষেত্রফল
= 1/2 × (সমান্তরাল বাহুদ্বয়ের যোগফল) × সমান্তরাল বাহুদ্বয়ের মধ্যবর্তী লম্ব দূরত্ব

ধরি,
সমান্তরাল বাহুদ্বয়ের মধ্যবর্তী লম্ব দূরত্ব = h cm

প্রশ্নানুসারে,
154 = (1/2) × (12 + 16) × h
⇒ 154 = (1/2) × 28 × h
⇒ 154 = 14h
⇒ h = 154/14
⇒ h = 11

অতএব, সমান্তরাল বাহুদ্বয়ের মধ্যবর্তী লম্ব দূরত্ব = 11 cm

questions.question: 80063. The average age of a group of 14 students is 17 years. When 7 more students join the group, the average age increases by 6 years. What is the average age of the new students?
questions.explain:
Question: The average age of a group of 14 students is 17 years. When 7 more students join the group, the average age increases by 6 years. What is the average age of the new students?

Solution:
14 জন শিক্ষার্থীর গড় বয়স = 17 বছর
সুতরাং, 14 জন শিক্ষার্থীর মোট বয়স = (14 × 17)
= 238 বছর

7 জন নতুন শিক্ষার্থী যোগ দেওয়ার পর মোট শিক্ষার্থীর সংখ্যা = 14 + 7 = 21 জন

নতুন গড় বয়স = 17 + 6
= 23 বছর

সুতরাং, 21 জন শিক্ষার্থীর মোট বয়স = (21 × 23)
= 483 বছর

এখন, নতুন 7 জন শিক্ষার্থীর মোট বয়স = 483 - 238
= 245 বছর

অতএব, নতুন 7 জন শিক্ষার্থীর গড় বয়স = 245 ÷ 7
= 35 বছর
